subtasks.name: usb-unplug
subtasks.prompt: The power strip is unplugged from the wall. Pull the orange USB cable out of the power strip and put it down on the table.
subtasks.check: Is the orange cable lying on the table, not plugged into the black power strip?
subtasks.context: The first image looks straight down at a table from above; the others come from cameras on the two robot grippers.
